name: Close-grip push-up sprints
description: Hands close together. Keep the sets short and crisp.

name: Overhead dumbbell extension
description: Slow extensions overhead. Keep the elbows pointed up.

name: Heavy skull crushers
description: Lower the bar toward the forehead with control.
caution: Heavy skull crushers can stress the elbows. Start light and stop if you feel sharp elbow pain.

name: Rope pushdown easy
description: Light rope pushdowns. Focus on smooth extension.

name: Bench dip shuffle
description: Short dips with a relaxed rhythm.

name: Band pushdown blast
description: Fast band pushdowns in short sets.
caution: Keep the elbows tucked. Stop if you feel elbow or wrist pain.

name: Diamond push-up pulse
description: Diamond push-ups with a short pulse at the bottom.

name: Gentle towel extensions
description: Use a towel for light, comfortable extensions.

name: Kickback flow
description: Slow kickbacks with a pause at the top.

name: Tempo close-grip press
description: Lower slowly, pause, and press. Keep the elbows in.

name: Cable overhead extension
description: Overhead cable extensions with a steady tempo.

name: Bodyweight dip hold
description: Short holds in a supported dip position.

name: Pushdown ladder
description: Climb from light to heavier pushdown sets.
